Your unforgettable experience
In the heart of the Queen Elizabeth National Park
Mweya Safari Lodge offers visitors an unforgettable experience. Located on a peninsula within the heart of the Queen Elizabeth National Park, Mweya Safari Lodge is surrounded by the magical Rwenzori Mountains aptly described as the 'Mountains of the Moon'.
To the east, lie the guardians of the birthplace of mankind, the Great Rift Valley hills, separated from the Mountains of the Moon by the meandering Kazinga Channel. Here the water flows endlessly into two giant lakes – Lake George and Lake Edward."We believe beyond doubt that unique encounters always begin off the beaten track..."

The Lodge
The Lodge
Embark on a Luxurious Wilderness Adventure at Mweya Safari Lodge! Nestled on a picturesque peninsula within Queen Elizabeth National Park and surrounded by the magical Rwenzori Mountains – the ‘Mountains of the Moon’ – our lodge offers a spectacular blend of luxury in the heart of the wilderness.
Discover an Array of Experiences: From thrilling game drives showcasing a diverse array of wildlife to luxurious boat trips on the Kazinga Channel and the chance to witness 619 bird species, Mweya Safari Lodge is your gateway to extraordinary encounters with nature. The breathtaking Kyambura Gorge nearby is home to chimpanzees and a variety of other wildlife.
Rooms with a View: Wake up to breathtaking vistas of the Kazinga Channel from every room, where forest hogs graze and curious hippos add to the spectacle. Culinary Excellence: Indulge in the highest quality Continental, Indian, and International cuisine that will tantalize your taste buds. Relax and Revitalize: After a day of adventure, unwind with a rejuvenating spa treatment at the Mweya Health Club.
Mweya Safari Lodge is not just a retreat; it s a journey of discovery where luxury seamlessly merges with the untamed beauty of the African wilderness.
